decisions.reason: The portable reference-class electrometer sits close to the firm's core dosimetry offer, so it costs little to carry, it is prominently featured on the home page, and buyers are only beginning to adopt it, which makes keeping the option clearly worthwhile.

The oncology risk management software extends the firm's QA platform toward its strategy of converging machine and patient QA, its value is still uncertain one year after launch, and software is cheap to maintain, so the firm keeps the option open rather than dropping it early.
